useConsecutiveDaysWarning.title: You are about to change how days are calculated.
useConsecutiveDaysWarning.description:
New leave requests will follow the new rule. Existing requests will keep the original calculation.
Do you want to continue?

workflowApproveHrWarning.title: You are about to change the approval workflow.
workflowApproveHrWarning.description:
Switching to HR-based approval means managers will no longer participate in requests and may be unassigned if not used in other leave types or groups.
Do you want to continue?

success.description: You can edit and manage licenses from the "Licenses" panel

workflowApprove.label: Approval workflow

tooltip.1:
The Manager validates leave requests from their Team but they remain pending HR approval, or rejects them without HR intervention.
HR approves or rejects requests whether or not they were validated by the Manager.
tooltip.2: HR manages all employee leave requests, performing their approval or rejection.
tooltip.3:
The Manager manages all leave requests from their Team, performing their approval or rejection.
HR approves or rejects requests from employees who do not have an assigned Manager.
tooltip.4:
The Manager validates leave requests from their Team but they remain pending HR approval, or rejects them without HR intervention.
HR approves or rejects requests once validated by the Manager. Also approves or rejects requests from employees who do not have an assigned Manager.

workflowApprove.1: Optional MANAGER approval and required HR

tooltip.consecutiveDays: All days are counted consecutively, including weekends and holidays
tooltip.businessDays: Only the company's business days are counted, excluding holidays defined in the work calendar

nextAbleDay.label: Starts on the first business day of the week
